description:
Join Pastors Ryan Johnson and James Rafferty for a fast-paced Bible Q&A tackling your biggest questions on forgiveness, judgment, and the afterlife. Topics include: forgiving someone who has died, whether God supports the death penalty, the destiny of Judas, what it means that “all Israel will be saved,” when Jesus crushed the serpent’s head, whether evil angels are bound or free, how to address loved ones believing the dead are in Heaven, and when the lost face final judgment. Clear, Bible-based answers that reveal God’s justice and mercy—don’t miss it!

Send us your Bible Questions! 
By email: BibleQA@3abn.org 


1. Can you forgive someone after they die and be truly forgiven by God? 

2. The New Testament teaches forgiveness; does this mean that God is no longer for the death penalty?  Is God against the death penalty?

3. Jesus knew Judas would betray Him at the Last Supper. Judas handed Him over for thirty pieces of silver, but later felt remorse and threw the money back to the religious leaders before taking his own life. So the question is, Will Judas be saved and raised in the first resurrection?  

4. My question centers on Romans 11:25–26. These verses seem to suggest that God has partially blinded Israel to allow time for the Gentiles’ salvation, and that later “all Israel will be saved.” How should we understand Romans 11:25–26 and the idea that all Israel will be saved? 

5. How should we interpret Jude 1:24–25 in the King James Version? 

6. Can you explain Ephesians 1:5? “he predestined us for adoption to sonship through Jesus Christ “. 

7. When did Jesus crush the devil's head? Was it at His birth, standing up to him while fasting for 40 days, using the Scriptures to him, Resurrection morning, or at His Coming? 

8.  If 2 Peter says evil angels are bound in chains of darkness, how can Ephesians say we’re fighting against spiritual forces? Are evil angels free or bound? 

9.  When someone joins the Church and says the Holy Spirit told them a recently deceased relative is in Heaven, are we supposed to gently share Scripture showing that the dead sleep and will not enter Heaven until Jesus returns?  Should we correct someone who says a loved one is in Heaven? 

10.  For those who die without Christ, do they face hell immediately at His coming, or only after the 1,000-year period? When do the dead without Christ face hell?
